description:

coverage and were either not targeted by the previous TODO or only partially
addressed. This plan brings each one individually to 80%+.

Testing philosophy: every test must assert on the actual output value or behavior
(SQL string content, config field value, error message). No import-only tests,
no assert-not-None, no mock.called checks in lieu of output assertions.

Cloud platform SQL generation tests: always assert the generated SQL string
contains specific clauses - COPY FROM S3, DISTRIBUTED BY, PARTITION BY, etc.

anti_patterns.dont: assert mock.called for SQL generation tests
anti_patterns.instead: always assert on the SQL string
anti_patterns.why: called=True doesn't verify the SQL is correct

anti_patterns.dont: mock internal helper functions to test a dispatcher
anti_patterns.instead: use real inputs and assert on real output
anti_patterns.why: you then test the mock, not the code

anti_patterns.dont: test only the happy path for CLI wrappers
anti_patterns.why: error validation is where bugs live

anti_patterns.dont: test that a config field 'is not None'
anti_patterns.why: that can never fail once the field is populated

anti_patterns.dont: write a test that only calls get_available_presets() and asserts len > 0
anti_patterns.why: that can't catch a bug where a preset is removed

deferrals.reason: Both require Spark session setup (SparkContext or SparkSession). PySpark tests already have a 1046-line test file at 23% because most tests skip when PySpark is not installed. Meaningful coverage requires a PySpark fixture or the separate dataframe platform CI environment. Cover in the dataframe-platform testing initiative, not here.

Azure Spark utilities require mocking Synapse/Fabric Spark session internals. Low ROI (only 30 missing lines) and fragile mock setup. Cover alongside other Azure Spark work when a real Spark session fixture is available.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: Explicitly deferred until a real Spark session fixture exists; no such fixture is tracked as available yet.

deferrals.reason: These are in the omit list of .coveragerc_core and were explicitly deferred in non-dataframe-test-coverage. Still deferred: high effort, niche benchmark, requires complex CDC/SCD fixtures. Cover after 80% overall target is sustained.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: Condition was 'after 80% overall coverage target sustained'; Makefile still sets suite-wide threshold at 70%, so condition unmet.
deferrals.summary: TPC-DI ETL modules (core/tpcdi/etl/batch.py 882 miss, transformations.py 1053 miss)

preserves.behavior: All existing tests must continue to pass - new tests are additive only
Cloud adapter tests must not require real credentials - mock at the connection boundary only
No assert-not-None, assert True, or hasattr-only assertions - every assertion must fail if the code under test is broken
SQL-generation assertions must check the actual SQL string content, not just that a method was called
Test file names must describe the behavior being tested, not contain 'coverage'
